title: Memory export refuses an empty basis when the committed data head has a memories tree but its envelope is missing or invalid
outcome: Memory export refuses an empty basis when the committed data head has a memories tree but its envelope is missing or invalid
acceptance: When the committed data head holds a memories tree and project.json is absent or invalid, export --include-memories refuses with a named code instead of treating the basis as empty, and a behavioural test shows that the other shared keys are not dropped

completion.summary: Completed and landed the memory export basis refusal fix; installed the exact candidate build on Central and verified readiness.
